title: The Spiritual Homilies
author: Macarius the Egyptian
edition: PG 34 Spiritual Homilies (Homiliae spirituales); tip densify Homilies 5–6 from OCR Greek
blurb: Macarius the Egyptian, Spiritual Homilies — tip densify of Homilies 5–6 (two worlds; resurrection garment) from PG 34 Greek OCR. New English for private study; prior PD English exists.
era_note: The Spiritual Homilies attributed to Macarius of Egypt belong to the fourth-century monastic tradition (Macarian corpus).
first_english_note: Prior English exists (e.g. Mason / Luibheid); this is a new rendering from locked PG 34 Greek for the tipped sections.

text_history.method: English densified from locked PG 34 OCR Greek for tip Homilies 5–6; Latin column/apparatus stripped; OCR damage disclosed; stigma header for Homily 6 lost in OCR so locus locked from Ἀγωνισώμεθα through Xanthicus before Homilia Ζ΄.
